title: Adaptive Phase-Switching for Communication-Efficient Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2609.13512v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated fine-tuning of large language models with low-rank adaptation reduces per-client trainable parameters, but client-to-server communication remains the dominant cost. Existing accounting for federated LoRA protocols omits the asymmetric transition round when a protocol changes aggregation mode, and reports savings that ignore grouped-query attention shapes. This paper measures per-round upload and download bytes for a bidirectional B-only federated LoRA protocol and places five methods, three from prior work, on a single communication-quality frontier. The frontier has a knee, which an adaptive phase-switching aggregator, ReverseAdaptive, locates by monitoring the relative improvement in global training loss against a dimensionless threshold rather than by fixing a phase boundary in advance. translated_title: 面向通信高效的联邦LoRA微调的自适应相位切换
translated_abstract: 使用低秩适应（LoRA）对大语言模型进行联邦微调减少了每个客户端的可训练参数量，但客户端到服务器的通信仍然是主要的成本开销。现有的联邦LoRA协议的统计口径忽略了协议切换聚合模式时的非对称过渡轮次，并且所报告的节省量未考虑分组查询注意力的参数形状。本文测量了一种双向仅B（B-only）联邦LoRA协议每轮的上传与下载字节数，并将五种方法（其中三种来自先前工作）置于同一条通信-质量前沿之上。该前沿存在一个拐点，自适应相位切换聚合器 ReverseAdaptive 通过监测全局训练损失的相对改进与一个无量纲阈值的比较来定位该拐点，而非预先固定相位边界。在 TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat 与 Alpaca 数据集上，ReverseAdaptive 相比 FLoRA 实现了40.5%的实测往返通信节省（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出自适应相位切换聚合器 ReverseAdaptive，通过监测全局训练损失的相对改进动态定位通信-质量前沿的拐点，在 TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat 上相比 FLoRA 实现了40.5%的实测往返通信节省。
en_tdlr: ReverseAdaptive, an adaptive phase-switching aggregator that locates the knee of the communication-quality frontier by monitoring relative improvement in global training loss, achieves 40.5% measured round-trip communication savings over FLoRA on TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat.
